MEMBERS OF PUNJAB LOCAL COUNCILS SERVICE (EFFICIENCY AND DISCIPLINE)
RULES, 1999
MEMBERS OF PUNJAB
LOCAL COUNCILS SERVICE (EFFICIENCY AND DISCIPLINE) RULES, 1999
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th June, 2001]
No. SOV(IG)1-30/81, dated
11-5-2000.--In exercise of the powers conferred upon him under subsection
(4) of section 42(B) read with section 167 of Punjab Local Government
Ordinance, 1979 (Revival of Law Act, 1997), the Governor of Punjab is pleased
to make the following Rules namely:--
CHAPTER - I
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title, commencement
and. application.--(1) These Rules may be called the Members of Punjab
Local Councils Service (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 1999.
(2) They shall come into force at
once and apply to all Members of Local Councils Service in the Punjab.
2. Definitions.--(1) In
these Rules unless the context otherwise requires:--
(a)
"Accused" means a member of Punjab Local Councils Service against
whom action is taken under these Rules.
(b)
"Authority" means the appointing authority or any officer or an
authority designated' by it to perform the functions of the authority under
these Rules.
(c)
"Enquiry Officer" means an officer appointed by the Authority to
perform the functions of an Enquiry Officer under these Rules.
(d)
"Enquiry Committee" means a group of officers (headed by a Convener)
appointed by the Authority to perform the functions of Enquiry Committee under
these Rules.
(e)
"Misconduct" means conduct prejudicial to good order or service
discipline or contrary to the provisions of such conduct rules as may be
applicable to the members of the Punjab Local Councils Service, or conduct
unbecoming of an officer and gentlemen and includes any act on the part of a
member of the Punjab Local Councils Service, to bring or attempt to bring
indirectly or other outside influence directly or indirectly to bear on the
Governor, the Chief Minister, a Minister or any Government Officer in respect
of any matter relating to the appointment, promotion, transfer, punishment,
retirement or other conditions of service.
(f)
"Penalty" means a penalty which may be imposed under these Rules.
(g)
"Government" means the Government of Punjab.
(h)
"Board" means the Punjab Local Government Board.
(i)
"Chairman" means the Chairman of the Punjab Local Government Board.
(j)
"Employee" means a member of the Punjab Local Council Service.
(2) In case two or more Members
of Local Councils Service are to be proceeded against jointly, the authority
for the Member of Local Councils Service senior-most in rank, shall be the
authority in respect of all such accused.
(3) Words and expressions used
but not defined shall bear the same meanings as they bear in the Punjab Local
Government Ordinance, 1979 or in the Punjab Local Councils Service (Appointment
and Conditions of Service) Rules, 1983.
(4) Save in cases where Board is
the Authority and notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in Rule 2,
where the authority would personally be interested in the result of the
proceeding under these Rules it shall not proceed with the case and shall
report the matter to the appellate authority to which the orders passed by 'the
authority' are ordinarily appealable and such appellate authority shall appoint
and authorise another officer of the corresponding rank and status to act as
the "authority".
CHAPTER - II
PENALTIES
3. Grounds for penalty.--A
member of the service who---
(a) is inefficient or has ceased
to be efficient; or
(b) is guilty of misconduct; or
(c) is corrupt, or may reasonably
be considered corrupt because--
(i) he is, or
any of his dependents or any other person through him or on his behalf is in
possession of pecuniary resources or of property disproportionate to his known
sources of income, which he cannot, reasonably account for; or
(ii) he has
assumed a style of living beyond his ostensible means; or
(iii) he has a
persistent reputation of being corrupt; or
(d) is engaged, or is reasonably
suspected of be

against under these Rules, and one or more of the penalties hereinafter
